overview.summary: Build a sortable comparison table showing all 8 debt payoff strategies side-by-side. The table displays key metrics (debt-free date, interest paid/saved, months saved, effort level) with column sorting and visual highlighting for baseline and recommended strategies.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Table shows columns: Strategy Name, Debt-Free Date, Total Interest Paid, Interest Saved vs Baseline, Months Saved, Effort Rating
Default sort is by interest saved (best first)
Clicking column header toggles sort ascending/descending
Recommended strategy row has teal highlight
Effort rating shows as badge (green=Low, amber=Medium, red=High)
On mobile, table converts to cards or horizontal scroll

architecture-constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations use big.js for precision
Strategy Pattern for debt reduction algorithms
All comparison logic runs in browser - no backend
Zustand for UI state (sorting, selected strategy)
Balanced Teal color system - teal-600 primary

interface.name: StrategyProjection
interface.field: Total interest paid over payoff period

component.name: WinnersPodium
component.description: Displays top 3 strategies in podium layout - reference for styling patterns

component.name: ComparePage
component.description: Page component with placeholder for ComparisonTable (line 81-89)
component.integration: Replace placeholder div with ComparisonTable component
component.ref: comparisonTableRef - existing ref for scroll-to-table behavior

component.name: formatCurrency
component.description: Formats numeric string as ZAR currency (R 1 234,56)

shadcn-components.component: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell

dependencies.package: Not needed for this story (charts in 5.3/5.4)
Icons - ArrowUpDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown for sorting

implementation-guidance.guidance: Use React.useState for sort column and direction. useMemo to derive sorted strategies array. Sort by comparing Big values using .cmp() for monetary fields.
low = bg-green-100 text-green-800 medium = bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 high = bg-red-100 text-red-800
Baseline: bg-slate-100 text-muted-foreground Recommended: bg-teal-50 border-l-4 border-teal-600
Use overflow-x-auto wrapper for horizontal scroll on mobile. Alternative: @media (max-width: 640px) show card layout instead.
Always call .toString() on Big values before passing to formatCurrency. Example: formatCurrency(strategy.interestSaved.toString())

test-ideas.test: Verify all 6 columns are rendered with correct headers
Default render shows strategies sorted by interestSaved descending
Click header -> verify sort direction toggles, rows reorder
Baseline row has muted/gray styling class
Row matching recommendedId has teal highlight class
Effort badges render with correct colors (green/amber/red)
Container has overflow-x-auto class for mobile scroll
Formats currency values in ZAR format
Sort by multiple columns (debtFreeDate, totalInterestPaid, etc.)

ux-requirements.requirement: Responsive breakpoint at 640px (sm:) for mobile layout

performance.strategy: Use useMemo for sorted array derivation
Avoid re-renders with React.memo if needed

related-prd-requirements.requirement: Comparison table with side-by-side strategy metrics
Sortable columns for debt-free date, interest, months saved
